params.name: points
params.label: Points
params.description: Number of points to generate along the chosen Shape. With Markers on, each one also gets a small marker sphere.

params.name: shape
params.label: Shape
params.description: Pattern the points are laid out in: Spiral, Line, Circle or a square Grid. None puts every point at the same spot. Placed automatically by the node's order in the network.

params.name: markers
params.label: Markers
params.description: true draws a small sphere at each point so they can be seen; false outputs bare points only, which is what Copy and other nodes should read.
